examples.name: Redis vs Memcached
examples.description: The Jira ticket says Redis; the engineering lead rejected it verbally in standup

sources.teams: Microsoft Teams — Aurora Billing / Sprint 41 Daily Scrum

sourceA.text: Introduce a Redis cache in front of the invoice read path — Stand up Redis as the caching layer for GET /api/customers/:id/invoices. Replace the Memcached wrapper in server/middleware/cache.js with a Redis client.

sourceB.text: So the decision is: we are NOT introducing Redis. We stay on Memcached and we optimise the existing wrapper instead.

conflicts.recommendationReason: source B explicitly rejects redis, which source A adopts. The meeting statement is more recent and came from the lead, so it is treated as the later decision — confirm before it is written into the manifest.

data.nextStep: Resolve each conflict in the widget, or call resolve_conflict with the conflict_id.

data.content:
# CLAUDE.md

> **Generated by the Enterprise Agentic Bridge.** Do not edit by hand.

## 0. Authoritative decisions (human-validated)

### redis, memcached, cache

**Ruling:** Authoritative: Microsoft Teams. We are NOT introducing Redis. We stay on Memcached and we optimise the existing wrapper instead.
